subject: Published CS2 dashboard build (snapshot generated 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z) — independent line-by-line re-verification
method: Each claim below was read from the published artefact named in `read_from` and compared with the official/first-party page named in `source_urls`. A value that could not be compared is marked unverified rather than filled in.

checks.claim: The executive summary's '19 active fixtures, 19 with a directional pick, 12 from an external betting line, 7 from a research model, 0 explicitly unresolved' matches the data it is rendered from.
checks.detail: origination.json counts: active 19, resolved 19, unresolved 0, with_pick 19, market 9, bookmaker 3, model 7, network 1 (network is counted inside model on the page). 9 + 3 = 12 external line, 7 model, 0 unresolved. The rendered Picks at a glance list contains exactly 19 rows: 9 data-method=market, 3 bookmaker, 7 model. Arithmetic and rendering agree.

checks.claim: Every one of the 19 glance rows carries a first-party Hotspawn link plus a source link for the number.
checks.detail: 19/19 rows contain a https://www.hotspawn.com/matches/... link and a second source link: 9 Polymarket event pages, 3 Thunderpick/Bovada API or event pages, 6 Valve standings or bo3.gg, plus the two DFRAG model rows. No row lacks a source URL.

checks.claim: HOTU and The Huns are priced from official Valve regional-standing points, and the cited points are correct.
checks.read_from: root index.html row 1082792 link target; official standings table
checks.detail: The 2026-10-05 standings list HOTU at standing 31 with 1437 points (roster dwushka, frontales, kade0, mizu, n0rb3r7) and The Huns at standing 122 with 944 points (roster Annihilation, Bart4k, bexyz, controlez, Cozen). The published 94.1% is consistent in magnitude with that 493-point gap under Valve's published 400-point logistic scale, which gives 94.5% before any rating-deviation treatment; the exact figure is replayed from the collector's saved evidence, not recomputed here. Labelled on the page as research model, not a market.

checks.claim: Ground Zero vs Off Chops (1082858) is a real fixture, BO3, and HLTV publishes no bookmaker odds for it.
checks.detail: HLTV 2399888: DFRAG Invitational 2026, Best of 3 (LAN), Group A opening match, Ground Zero HLTV #143 / VRS #131. The Betting block contains one Stake US sweepstakes promo row with 'No promocode available' and no decimal odds. The HLTV fan poll (42.9% / 57.1%) is excluded evidence and is not a probability.

checks.claim: The published snapshot is complete for the lobby as it stood when it was collected, and the coverage gap seen later is caused by the refresh failing, not by a pick-logic gap.
checks.read_from: live lobby vs published snapshot at 2026-10-24T06:35Z
checks.detail: 25 cards live; 16 are in the snapshot; 9 are not, all scheduled after the last successful collect. The three failed runs cited in the flag all failed at the regression step before collection, which is upstream of every pick source. Details in data/research/e619b921/live-coverage.json.

checks.claim: The two fixtures that the featured layer leaves blank (1082858, 1082792) do carry a labelled pick on the page, from the complete researched list rather than from a market.
checks.read_from: root index.html glance rows vs root snapshot.json analysis
checks.detail: snapshot.json marks both fixtures analysis=null (counts.picks 17, counts.unresolved 2), while the rendered page shows 1082858 Off Chops 55.1% (network model, bo3.gg source link) and 1082792 HOTU 94.1% (Valve). The page is rendered from the reconciled origination layer; the JSON snapshot keeps the featured-layer counts, and the page labels the block accordingly. No 50/50 default is used anywhere.

checks.claim: Hotspawn '% picked' crowd percentages are absent from every probability on the page.
checks.read_from: root index.html; scripts/build.py policy constants; origination policy
checks.detail: origination.json policy records hotspawn_votes_used false and fan_votes_used false. The policy ladder in the same file lists only priced providers, labelled relays, aggregators and research models. The lobby cards' crowd percentages (for example HOTU 97% / The Huns 3%) contradict the model's direction nowhere used as an input.

checks.claim: The page's own staleness banner is truthful for the observation window.
checks.read_from: root index.html data-snapshot-generated vs wall clock
checks.detail: generated_at 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z, stale_after_hours 8, observed 2026-10-24T06:35Z = 10h25m. The banner is rendered, so the page does not present stale numbers as current.

unverified.item: Exact no-vig arithmetic of the 12 external-line rows
unverified.why: The per-row quote arrays live in the collector's refresh output and generated evidence for the 2026-10-23T20:10Z snapshot, which is not in this checkout (the checked-in data/*.json is the deterministic 2026-10-15 replay fixture). Recomputing them from a different file would be a fabrication, so this session did not restate them. The build's own replay audit (80 source rows, 0 without a source) runs on every refresh and is the mechanism that checks them.

unverified.item: Five derived start times for lobby cards 1081152, 1081153, 1081154, 1081156, 1081158
unverified.why: The lobby renders US Eastern; no UTC-rendering source was read for those five in this session.
unverified.handling: each row is labelled starts_at_basis=lobby_card_us_eastern_plus_4h; the collector API epoch supersedes them on the next refresh

unverified.item: HLTV Betting block for the eight live cards other than 1082858
unverified.why: Read budget; identity for those cards was checked on Hotspawn, not HLTV.
unverified.handling: stated as a limitation in the dossier and in the flag; the runner re-tries HLTV every refresh (HTTP 403 there, documented)

irregularities: Hotspawn header counter (224) does not agree with its own filter totals (88); earlier sessions recorded 203 vs 92 and 68 vs 88. Flagged; the counters are never used as inventory.
EGamersWorld publishes identical 1.8/1.8 for five of the nine uncovered fixtures and renders one opponent name blank. Rejected as non-market, never converted.
Three consecutive scheduled refreshes failed before collecting; the published snapshot was 10h25m old at the observation.

The feature layer (snapshot.json) and the complete researched layer (origination.json) disagree on the count of unresolved fixtures by design (2 vs 0). Both are published and labelled; a reader comparing the two files must read the labels.
